entry.title: Jay-Z to Perform at Super Bowl 2027 Halftime Show | E! News

media:group.media:title: Jay-Z to Perform at Super Bowl 2027 Halftime Show | E! News
media:group.media:description:
Jay-Z has been chosen to headline the Super Bowl 2027 Halftime Show on Feb. 14, ESPN announced. While Jay-Z's Roc Nation produces the show, this will be his first time taking center stage at the game. “From Reasonable Doubt to standing on the Super Bowl Halftime stage, this has been a journey,” Jay-Z, born Shawn Carter, shared in a statement to Variety. “Thirty years of music, work, and culture on the world’s biggest stage. This run continues to be a dream come true.”While Jay-Z, who shares daughter Blue Ivy, 14, and 9-year-old twins Rumi and Sir with wife Beyoncé, has never performed at the Super Bowl, he’s hardly a stranger to the halftime show. entry.title: Zendaya Makes Surprise Visit at Nephew EJ Coleman’s Football Game | E! News

media:group.media:title: Zendaya Makes Surprise Visit at Nephew EJ Coleman’s Football Game | E! News
media:group.media:description:
Zendaya attended her nephew EJ Coleman’s Senior Night football game in Folsom, Calif., and the Dune actress didn’t fumble the opportunity to score some major aunt points. In a picture shared to his Instagram Oct. 25, EJ—the son of Zendaya’s half-brother Julien “EZ” Coleman—posed alongside the actress, who sported a fuzzy green coat over a custom shirt with EJ’s picture on it and a pair of jeans emblazoned with his name and jersey number. The Euphoria alum’s mom Claire Stoermer also celebrated the special family moment with a post worthy of an endzone celebration, writing on her Instagram Stories alongside the picture, “Such a great night!! Beyond proud of @ej_cole007!! Thanks to all the Folsom High School kids for being so respectful.” Of course, the moment under the Friday night lights was a no-brainer for Zendaya as she’s been adamant about how being with family is her way to maintain normalcy. entry.title: Rob Kardashian Reacts to His Rare Outing Going Viral | E! News

media:group.media:title: Rob Kardashian Reacts to His Rare Outing Going Viral | E! News
media:group.media:description:
Rob Kardashian revealed to ex Blac Chyna how he really felt about going viral after making a rare public appearance at sister Kim Kardashian's birthday. “Oh, and I wanted to tell you, too, I seen your pictures, too, on the internet,” Chyna, 38, said on the Oct. 24 Kick livestream shared to social media. “And everybody’s like, ‘Ooo, Rob! Rob!’ They’re going crazy over you.” Rob admitted he was surprised by the attention from the rare appearance, quipping, “I don’t know why they’re saying that, ‘cause I felt like I looked crazy. But it’s OK.” However, Chyna (real name Angela White) assured her ex that was “being modest,” saying, “Nah, the pictures was fire.” Still, the Aurthur George founder couldn't help his thoughts, with the 39-year explaining, “No, that’s just how I feel. But it’s all good. All good.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1437493/rob-kardashian-reacts-to-going-viral-on-kim-kardashians-birthday

entry.title: All My Children's Alan Dysert Dead at 75 After Cancer Battle | E! News

media:group.media:title: All My Children's Alan Dysert Dead at 75 After Cancer Battle | E! News
media:group.media:description:
All My Children alum Alan Dysert died Oct. 23 at age 75, nearly three years after he shared he had been diagnosed with a rare incurable cancer in his autobiography Lights, Camera, Cancer! Dysert played Sean Cudahy in 79 episodes of the beloved soap opera from 1980 to 1990, though his wife Michelle Dysert said thousands also knew him as an acting teacher and mentor who encouraged others to pursue their dreams. In a heartfelt tribute, Michelle remembered her husband as a “life changer” with a gift for storytelling and asked loved ones to celebrate the joy he brought into the world; he is survived by Michelle and sons Cody and Cooper.
